title: Not Worth the Money
text: I signed up for the science expedition because my 8 year old daughter has been begging to try Little Passports for a long time.  She was really excited to get the first box and we opened it together, only to be underwhelmed.  The instructions/brochure was fine but the tools included were pretty cheap quality.  More annoying though was that not every item that was needed for the projects was included in the box.  Things like salt or dish soap are ok to expect people to have at hand in the house, but red tempura paint??  When I saw that ingredient, I thought for sure my daughter had missed seeing a little container of paint in the package, but nope, it's listed as a home item in the directions for the project.  There were no suggestions for substitutes either so since I was not going to run out to buy tempura paint in order to just use a few drops, that meant that one of the three projects in the box was wasted.  It's too bad because the concept sounds good, just not worth $25 a month, especially when you have to supply a lot of the components yourself.
label: negative
